summary.text: Rosemary Aahanna-Hill is the Democratic candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 7th Plymouth District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Alyson Sullivan-Almeida.
Ballotpedia lists her, formerly Rosemary Connolly, as a current officeholder of the Whitman-Hanson Regional School District, with a term ending in 2027.
